# Bots and agents policy

## Sole owner

**Pam Richardson** (`Pjrich1313`) is the sole owner.

## Allowed agent

| Agent | Role |
|-------|------|
| GitHub Copilot | Coding agent only — no ownership |

## Banned without explicit owner request

- Unsolicited Copilot / Claude / Codex sessions
- Dependabot auto-PRs (optional; owner may leave security updates)
- Auto-merge of any PR

## How to turn agents off (UI)

1. https://github.com/settings/copilot — disable coding agent / third-party agents for this repo if desired
2. Repo **Settings → Code security** — Dependabot
3. https://github.com/copilot/agents — stop running sessions on `Pamela-`
